ideas.title: Investigating the Use of Force by Federal Agents
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the shooting of a 37-year-old man by federal agents in Minneapolis, and examine the use of force by federal agents in similar incidents.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
How often do federal agents use force in similar incidents?
searches: use of force by federal agents
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a pattern of misconduct by federal agents, and to hold them accountable for their actions. By investigating the use of force by federal agents, we can shed light on a critical issue that affects the public's trust in law enforcement.
